context_assumptions: The current speaker is the driver talking to their own race engineer during a live race.
No live telemetry values or verified incidents are supplied. Annotate the intended question, never its factual answer.
Only supplied dialogue resolves omitted topics or references. Conventional short radio requests may refer to the driver's current race state.
